findings.statement: Declared as an Individual, but the trading name 'Anything Worxx inc.' claims to be a corporation. The NC Secretary of State business search page states automated or scripted searches are not permitted, so no registry query was run; indexed results showed no NC entity named Anything Worxx/Worx/Works. The Town of Waynesville taxi ordinance requires a certificate of public convenience and necessity and a driver taxi permit for passengers carried for hire within town limits; no public permit register exists to check.
findings.establishes: no NC entity confirmed; registry blocks automation; taxi permit status unknown

findings.statement: No listing, Facebook page, Google Business presence or directory entry places 'Anything Worxx' as a ride or taxi service in Waynesville / Haywood County. Service business without licensed premises: no points.
findings.establishes: no independent footprint found in Waynesville

findings.statement: Representative name not available to the verifier on this run.
findings.establishes: representative not checked (feed has no entry for this account)

findings.statement: No website declared; personal gmail. Neither handle nor business name describes payment collection. The statement descriptor is a personal name, not a random string, and does not match the business name.

The self-description 'I give rides in exchange for compensation' is coherent with MCC 4121 on its face, but no ride/taxi activity under this name was observable. 'Anything Worxx' suggests odd-jobs work rather than transport.
No independent presence, reviews, news, complaints or fraud reports found.
findings.establishes: no history and no adverse reports

evidenceNeeded: Explain the 'inc.' in the business name on an Individual account: provide NC articles of incorporation, or confirm sole proprietorship and correct the name.
Manual NC SOS Business Registration and assumed-name search for 'Anything Worxx'; Haywood County Register of Deeds DBA check.
Town of Waynesville certificate of public convenience and necessity and driver taxi permit, or confirmation that pickups are outside town limits; proof of for-hire auto insurance.
Representative identity and Stripe KYC status; consider a descriptor matching the business name.
summary: No public record of 'Anything Worxx inc.' was found: no NC entity in indexed registry results, no social or listing presence in Waynesville, no history or complaints. NC SOS does not permit automated search, so the registry needs a manual check. Under the Individual rubric every dimension scores 0, but an 'inc.' name on an Individual account with a personal-name descriptor is an inconsistency to resolve, and the town's taxi ordinance requires permits whose status is unknown.
